title: Automated true vertical line determination for orthognathic surgery virtual planning using smartphone photography and open-source applications
html: This technical note describes a novel method for recording the natural head position (NHP) for virtual surgical planning (VSP) in orthognathic surgery using a smartphone and open-source software. The authors utilize the OpenCamera application on standard smartphones to capture clinical photographs. This app embeds critical device orientation data, including roll, pitch, and yaw from the built-in accelerometer, directly into the image metadata. These photographs are then imported into a custom module (MaxiSlicer) developed for the open-source 3DSlicer platform.
